messages:
sara (partner-eng): Heads up — partner XYZ reported marketplace VMs failing after our runtime update. Repro looks specific to CUDA 12.2 + Nvidia driver 540.x. :warning:

mike (hw-eng): Which tests are failing? any stack traces? :eyes:

sara (partner-eng): Small smoke & startup tests. Error snippet from partner logs: `cuInit(0) -> CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN` on some nodes. CI link: https://ci.internal/driver-ci/job/2345 (logs attached).

driver-ci (bot): job 2345 — test/gpu/smoke — FAILURE. image: ubuntu-22.04-cuda-12.2. See /artifacts/logs/smoke-2345.txt

julio (platform): That smells like a driver/kernel ABI mismatch. 540.x had a change that affected module loading on older kernels. Did marketplace images pin driver versions?

tanya (pm-partnerships): Marketplace image manifests currently pin `CUDA=12.0` in most published images, but some partners built their own bundles and bumped to 12.2 which may have pulled a newer driver. Partners are asking for a clear "supported stacks" doc to avoid regressions.

sara (partner-eng): Can we put together a minimal recommended pin list and a short hotfix plan? Partners need guidance ASAP so they can revert if needed.

mike (hw-eng): Proposed minimal recommended pins (for now):

```
NVIDIA_DRIVER=535.86
CUDA=12.1
cuDNN=8.9
ROCm=5.4  # AMD nodes: verify 5.4 compat matrix
```

mike (hw-eng): Also recommend that any custom marketplace images include the exact driver package name and kernel-headers match.

julio (platform): Agree. Add this note: "If distro kernel < 5.15, you must pin driver <= 535.x or rebuild against kernel-headers." Also I'll add a quick router fallback: if CUDA 12.2 fails healthcheck, route to 12.1 pool.

tanya (pm-partnerships): Ops/marketing question: do we want to surface this as a joint advisory with partners or an internal note for integrators? I'd prefer a joint advisory so marketplace customers see it. Need coordination with partner-srv and marketplace teams.

sara (partner-eng): I'll coordinate partner comms. Proposed actions: 1) mike validates hotfix + CI on Dedicated pool, 2) julio adds routing fallback + gating checklist for marketplace images, 3) tanya coordinates advisory/announce with partner-srv, 4) sara sends partner-facing guidance. ETA: EOD tomorrow?

mike (hw-eng): I'll run validation tonight on a Dedicated instance and open a branch `hotfix/driver-pinning-2026-03-21`. Will post failing vs passing matrix here. :thumbsup:

driver-ci (bot): New build queued: hotfix/driver-pinning-2026-03-21 -> test/gpu/smoke

sara (partner-eng): Thanks. I'll schedule a short sync Thu 10am PT with partner-success + marketplace engineering and prepare a one-page advisory draft. @tanya please loop in legal if we mention partner names. :calendar:

tanya (pm-partnerships): Will do. Also will add a small checklist for partners: pin driver, pin CUDA minor version, ensure kernel-headers match, and provide test image links.

julio (platform): I'll put the gating checklist as a PR in the marketplace repo and add the fallback router rule.

sara (partner-eng): Great — keep updates here. If any partner sees this in prod, ask them to toggle back to `CUDA=12.1` (or our pinned image) while we ship the hotfix. :shipit:

sara (partner-eng): ccing partner-success and marketplace-signal channels for visibility.
